resource: One-item DUR-03 loot MINTs in flight at once across one runtime scope, across every death and loot-settlement workflow in it
allocation_impact: Checked once per death, before any entry of its loot plan is frozen, against the scope's already in-flight count the caller supplies; the whole plan is rejected up front rather than minting some entries and stopping partway.
boundary_tests: max=64: 48 already in flight plus a 16-entry plan is accepted (check_inflight_loot_mint_capacity(48, 16))
max+1=65: 49 already in flight plus a 16-entry plan is rejected before any entry is frozen (check_inflight_loot_mint_capacity(49, 16))
a single entry against an already-full scope (64 in flight) is rejected (check_inflight_loot_mint_capacity(64, 1))
an overflowing caller-supplied count (usize::MAX) is rejected rather than wrapping
consumers: apps/game-server/src/combat/death_reward.rs (check_inflight_loot_mint_capacity, called from settle_loot before the first freeze_item_mint of a death's plan)
notes: D78, decision §4.1 row 7: "64, jak potwory" (matching the D57 creature envelope). D2b enforces this as a pure guard over a caller-tracked in-flight count; no scope-wide MINT tracker is added by this task. Registered by OTV2-20260928-combat-d2b-death-reward-wiring.
